verses.text: By David. Judge me, LORD, because I’ve lived with integrity and trusted you without wavering.
Examine me, LORD, and put me to the test. Search my heart and mind.
I keep your faithful love before my eyes and live by your truth.
I’ve never sat with liars, and I won’t join people who pretend to be what they aren’t.
I hate the gatherings of evildoers and won’t sit with the wicked.
I’ll wash my hands in innocence and walk around your altar, LORD,
so I can thank you aloud and tell of all your wonderful deeds.
LORD, I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.
Don’t take my life along with sinners or sweep me away with bloodthirsty people.
Their hands are busy with evil, and their right hands are full of bribes.
But I’ll keep living with integrity. Redeem me and have mercy on me.
My feet stand on level ground. I’ll bless the LORD in the gatherings of his people.
